title: Vehicle Masters
desc: Vehicle Masters is a minimalist arcade parking challenge with over 40 increasingly difficult levels. Maneuver your car through tight spaces, avoid obstacles, and park perfectly in the marked spot. Each level introduces new layouts &mdash; narrow alleys, moving barriers, sharp corners, and crowded lots. What makes it unique? Simple controls with realistic physics: steering plus manual gear shifting (forward and reverse). On desktop you control gears manually with keys; on mobile you only steer &mdash; gears switch automatically for smooth gameplay. With clean visuals and progressive difficulty, this game tests precision and patience. P
howto: Park inside the green zone without hitting walls or obstacles Complete each level to unlock the next Desktop ndash Arrow keys or WASD to steer R for reverse gear D for drive gear Spacebar for brake Mobile ndash Only steering mdash tap left rig
tips: Read the next obstacle early before making a move.
Use small, steady inputs instead of overcorrecting.
Restart quickly and learn the pattern one attempt at a time.
